about: Neural network models for time series forecasting, built to be easy to use and to scale.

prs.title: Models with a probability loss can be saved right after training
prs.broken: Saving a model right after training failed when it used one of the probability losses. The loss still held a link to the training math that could not be copied.
prs.changed: That link is now dropped where the loss is built. It was only needed for predictions, which still work the same.
prs.matters: People can train a forecasting model and save it straight away without a crash.
